info.description:
Items, structures and follower skins from *Cult of the Lamb*, taken from the game (version 1.4.6, captured 2026-10-29T12:00:00Z). Static JSON: no keys, no rate limits, open CORS. Within `v1/` fields are only added, never removed.

What changed with each game version: [changes.json](/v1/changes.json). Field-by-field documentation and examples: the [README](https://github.com/AuthFailed/cotl-api#readme).

Unofficial fan project; the game, its data and art belong to Massive Monster and Devolver Digital. Source: [github.com/AuthFailed/cotl-api](https://github.com/AuthFailed/cotl-api).
